verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an official MCP server that lets Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other MCP clients query production logs and run evals. A probe confirms the server exists. A REST API covers "all aspects of the platform," and the `bt` CLI can browse, query, and pull logs locally, so an agent has several programmatic routes into trace data for debugging. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of querying metrics and past eval/experiment results (rather than just running evals) via MCP/API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.
